_comment: Configurable seed-bank domain rules used by seedsql/validator.py. These are documented project assumptions, not universal agricultural facts. Change thresholds or phrases here; no code change is needed.

schema.stock_semantics: SeedLot.quantity is the CURRENT stock after all distributions; subtracting Distribution.quantity from it double-counts.

rules.check: sql has per-lot latest-test selection (MAX(test_date) correlated / window ROW_NUMBER / ORDER BY test_date DESC with grouping)
rules.feedback: Select the most recent germination test separately for each lot (e.g. test_date = (SELECT MAX(test_date) ... WHERE lot_id = outer.lot_id)) before applying any threshold.

rules.check: a MAX(test_date) subquery is correlated with the outer lot (WHERE ...lot_id = outer.lot_id) or grouped by lot_id
rules.feedback: The latest test must be found for EACH lot: correlate the MAX(test_date) subquery on lot_id (or GROUP BY lot_id). A subquery over the whole table returns only the single newest test in the database.

rules.check: every year/date bound stated in the question appears in the SQL date filter
rules.feedback: Restrict the date column to exactly the period stated in the question (dates are TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD').

rules.check: sql excludes records that have a later test on the same lot (NOT EXISTS / MAX)
rules.feedback: Exclude results that have a later germination test on the same lot (NOT EXISTS a test with a greater test_date).

rules.check: the germination threshold and comparison direction stated in the question appear in the SQL
rules.feedback: Apply the germination threshold exactly as stated: 'below N%' is germination_rate < N, 'at least N%' is germination_rate >= N.
Only count lots with stock: add SeedLot.quantity > 0.

rules.check: sql does not subtract Distribution.quantity from SeedLot.quantity
rules.feedback: SeedLot.quantity is already the current stock after distributions; do not subtract Distribution.quantity from it.

rules.check: temperature and humidity limits stated in the question appear with the right logical connective
rules.feedback: A reading is out of range if temperature > limit OR humidity > limit, using the limits stated in the question.

rules.check: every join between seed-bank tables uses the documented foreign-key pair
rules.feedback: Join SeedLot to SeedVariety on variety_id, and GerminationTest / StorageLog / Distribution to SeedLot on lot_id.

rules.check: an aggregate asked 'for each X' has a GROUP BY
rules.feedback: Group by the entity the question names ('for each X') and aggregate within each group.

rules.check: a 'how many' question returns a count
rules.feedback: Return a COUNT for 'how many' questions (use COUNT(DISTINCT ...) when entities can repeat across joins).

rules.check: sql references only existing tables and columns
rules.feedback: Use only the tables and columns listed in the schema.

rules.check: no outer SELECT mixes aggregate functions with plain columns without GROUP BY (SQLite accepts this silently)
rules.feedback: When the SELECT list mixes aggregates with plain columns, GROUP BY the plain columns.

metamorphic._comment: Gold-free semantic tests: the database is changed in a controlled way and the predicted SQL is re-run. The expected change in its output follows from the question's intent alone.
